in0 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_fill_c[0]
in1 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_zero_c[0]
in2 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_scale[0]
for a0 in 0..64:
    for a1 in 0..8192:
        for a2 in 0..8192:
            for a3 in 0..128:
                in3 = load x1[0, a0 / 8, a2, a3]
                in4 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a3]
                f32 v0 = multiply(in3, in4)
                acc1 <- add(acc1, v0) over a3
            v1 = multiply(acc1, in2)
            v2 = select:
                in1 when a2 <= a1
                in0 when a1 < a2
            v3 = add(v2, v1)
            acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v3) over a2
        for a2 in 0..8192:
            for a5 in 0..128:
                in5 = load x1[0, a0 / 8, a2, a5]
                in6 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a5]
                f32 v4 = multiply(in5, in6)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v4) over a5
            v5 = multiply(acc3, in2)
            v6 = select:
                in1 when a2 <= a1
                in0 when a1 < a2
            v7 = add(v6, v5)
            v8 = subtract(v7, acc0)
            v9 = exp(v8)
            acc2 <- add(acc2, v9) over a2
        for a6 in 0..128:
            for a7 in 0..8192:
                for a8 in 0..128:
                    in7 = load x1[0, a0 / 8, a7, a8]
                    in8 = load x0[0, a0, a1, a8]
                    f32 v10 = multiply(in7, in8)
                    acc5 <- add(acc5, v10) over a8
                v11 = multiply(acc5, in2)
                in9 = load x2[0, a0 / 8, a7, a6]
                v12 = select:
                    in1 when a7 <= a1
                    in0 when a1 < a7
                v13 = add(v12, v11)
                v14 = subtract(v13, acc0)
                v15 = exp(v14)
                v16 = divide(v15, acc2)
                v17 = multiply(in9, v16)
                acc4 <- add(acc4, v17) over a7
            scaled_dot_product_attention[0, a0, a1, a6] = acc4
